title: bro_wait did not return when watched task completed
wanted_capability: bro_wait(task_id, timeout_seconds) should return promptly when the watched task transitions to a terminal state (completed/failed/cancelled).
notes: Probe task 41b9497a-4f4c-45d9-aa59-a22640161830 (brodex gpt-5.5, 69 turns, 4894 events) completed and bro_status returned status=completed with full result/snapshot. bro_wait was called with timeout_seconds=300 and was rejected by the user after more than 300s had elapsed — the task had completed but bro_wait had not returned. This blocks the standard probe orchestration loop (dispatch → wait → verify → retro) and forces a manual bro_status poll instead of the intended blocking wait primitive.
resolution_note: Root-caused and fixed in src/orchestration/mod.rs. Incident timeline: bro_wait entered at 2026-06-14T17:49:01Z with timeout_seconds=300; at 2026-06-14T17:54:01Z the daemon hit the timeout path and panicked while constructing timeout_snapshot_json, slicing last_assistant_message with clean[..80] through a UTF-8 curly apostrophe. The wait timeout itself fired; the response task died before returning the timeout snapshot, leaving the caller pending until operator interruption. Fix: timeout_snapshot_json now truncates lastAssistantSnippet with chars().take(80), and regression timeout_snapshot_truncates_last_activity_on_char_boundary covers the exact byte-boundary panic shape.
